content: यवः [यु-अच्] .²1 Barley; यवाः प्रकीर्णा न भवन्ति शालयः <ls>Mk. 4. 17</ls>. .²2 A barley-corn or the weight of a barley-corn; <ls>Ms. 8. 134</ls>. .²3 A measure of length equal to ¹⁄₆ or ¹⁄₈ of an {%aṅgula%}. .²4 A mark on the fingers of the hand resembling a barley-corn and supposed according to its position to indicate wealth, progeny, good fortune <ab>&c.</ab>; समग्रयवमच्छिद्रं पाणिपादं च वर्णवत् <ls>Rām. 6. 48. 13</ls>. .²5 The first half of a month; also याव. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of a particular astronomical Yoga. .²7 Speed, velocity; <ab>cf.</ab> जव. .²8 A double convex lens. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of an island.
